answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 22102 Country: India Title: By the grace of Allah I got baby boy. Please suggest me which name (with meaning) is best for my son among this Mohammed Zahhan,Mohammed rayhan and Mohammed Izhan? Question: By the grace of Allah I got baby boy. Please suggest me which name (with meaning) is best for my son among this Mohammed Zahhan,Mohammed rayhan and Mohammed Izhan? Answer ID: 22102 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 968/785/B=1431) Muhammad Raihan is a good name. Raihan occurs in the beginning of surah al-Rahman. It is mentioned in hadith that when someone is presented raihan (smelling flower) he should not refuse it; because it is not costly and bears fragrance. It is also mentioned in another hadith that when someone is presented fragrance he should not refuse it because it comes from jannah. و في الحديث من عرض عليه ريحان فلا يرده فإنه خفيف المحمل طيب الريح . مسلم وفي رواية: إذا أعطي أحدكم الريحان فلا يرده فإنه خرج من الجنة . الترمذي (مشكاة ، 260-261) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
